decisions.statement: A release is covered where its tracks run as long as the release runs.
A release that is covered states a length of its own of nothing.
A release that is covered states a progress of its own of nothing.
A release that is not covered keeps the length and the progress it states.
A release carries every track naming that release.
A track naming two releases is carried by both of them.
A release carrying no track is not covered.
A release stating no length is not covered.
A release already stating nothing of its own is left as that release is.
Two lengths within a hundredth of a minute are one length.
Every release changed lands as a single commit or does not land.
Nothing here works out what a release runs or how far Alan is through it.

definition: the command taking a release's own length away once its tracks carry it
